<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex031022026-04-1608-43-48" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (52b5-52b6)"/>
      <l>  rigs pa chen po sa stengs ma lus pa na | </l>
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">smra ba'i glang po chen po</rs> spyi bos <note type="gloss">ma</note> gnod par mdzad pa'i seng ge ||</l>
        <l>phyogs ma lus par snyan sgra rab tu grags pa can ||</l>
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3765">slob dpon shag kya 'od</rs> kyis sbyar ba'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4688"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3766">'dul ba 'od ldan</rs> gyi stod smad kyi ti ka</rs> smra ba'i seng ge chen por gyur pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3942">dge slong bstan pa'i mnga' <lb n="52b6"/> bdag byang chub rdo rje</rs>s<note type="editorial">Tentative identification as rMa tsho Byang chub rdo rje (ID:3942)</note> nye bar sbyar ba las slad kyis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3818">shag kya'i dge slong brtson 'grus 'bar</rs> gyis | tshig ma bkrol ba'i don rnams kyang legs par kha bskangs ste gzhan la phan pa'i don du bkod pa'o   |</seg></TEI>
